title: Psyche
summary: In Rome, a young sculptor crafted a statue of Psyche out of pure Carrara marble. The figure radiated such heavenly innocence that the artist fell to his knees in sacred adoration....
full_text:
In Rome, a young sculptor crafted a statue of Psyche out of pure Carrara marble. The figure radiated such heavenly innocence that the artist fell to his knees in sacred adoration.

Driven by an unworthy worldly temptation, he nearly shattered his own soul in guilt, renounced the world, and became a cloistered monk, burying the marble statue beneath the earth.

Centuries later, excavators unearthed the marble Psyche. Its earthly form was celebrated in royal museums, while the purified soul of the artist had long since reached the eternal kingdom of divine beauty.
moral: The marble statue of human art decays, but the living soul of beauty ascends to eternity.
